items.caption: In the received analysis of 語, 言 is the meaning-bearing element; this modern seal-script-style drawing shows the component form.
items.alt: A horizontal stroke above a complex, vertically arranged seal-script form of 言.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the semantic component identified in the received analysis of 語.

items.caption: The received analysis names 吾 as 語’s sound-bearing element; this modern seal-script-style drawing shows 吾 in that style.
items.alt: A seal-script form of 吾 with broad upper and lower strokes around crossing diagonals, above a box-like lower component.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the phonetic element named in the traditional analysis. Its shape alone does not establish the historical sound relationship.

limitations.text: These drawings show the components in modern Shuowen seal-script-style renderings, not the compound 語 or its early inscription forms. Early bronze and Warring States forms are reported, but their glyphs and the earliest phonetic shape’s referent are not verified here.
